remarks: Welcome to your very own slice of paradise on the Norwalk River and Harbour & the best value within the complex! Features that make this unit standout: new in August of 2022- high efficiency heating & central air cooling system, two upgraded bathrooms, fireplace upgrade & recently professionally painted - compare! This highly sought-after top-floor unit boasts vaulted ceilings and an abundance of natural light, creating an airy and welcoming atmosphere. Imagine sipping your morning coffee or enjoying a glass of wine in the evening on your private balcony, overlooking the tranquil water with breathtaking views and stunning sunsets. The open-concept living space is perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. Desirable natural gas for heating & cooking. Washer/dryer in unit. Convenience is at your doorstep with this prime location. You're just minutes away from shopping, parks, schools, beaches, marinas, golf courses, and the East Norwalk Train Station (0.9 miles). Enjoy the vibrant nightlife and shopping at the Sono Collection Mall, all within easy reach, along with quick access to highways for effortless commuting. The well-maintained building features secure entry, private parking, and an elevator for your convenience. Experience the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience in this exceptional waterfront property. Welcome Home!
